name: @cloudsforge/ledger
description: Double-entry accounting: the financial source of truth. Accounts, journal entries, postings, balances, reservations, reconciliation.

scripts._test: --test-concurrency=1 is required, not a preference: every database test file truncates the ledger between cases, and node:test runs FILES in parallel by default. A TRUNCATE takes an AccessExclusiveLock, so one file's reset deadlocks against another file's inserts (40P01). Cases within a file already run in order.

_localDependencies: The @cloudsforge/* packages are consumed from sibling checkouts because none of them is
published yet. Once AD-02 lands they all become registry versions ('^1.0.0') and these paths —
plus the two build contexts in the Dockerfile and the extra checkouts in CI — are deleted.
Nothing else in this repository changes.
The runtime packages take 'file:' and the contracts packages take 'link:', and the difference
is not cosmetic. @cloudsforge/contracts-money depends on @cloudsforge/contracts-chain with the
'workspace:^' protocol, which only resolves inside the contracts workspace. 'file:' would make
pnpm try to resolve that transitive itself and fail; 'link:' symlinks the package in place and
lets it keep using its own already-installed node_modules. The runtime packages have no
first-party transitives, so they take the same 'file:' the service template uses.
tsx is a runtime dependency for the same reason: the unpublished packages resolve to their
TypeScript sources. On publish their publishConfig points at dist/, tsx moves to
devDependencies, and the image runs 'node dist/index.js'.
